diagnosticGaps.message: Milestone ledger has 6 row(s), above the 5 row threshold for high_assurance. Record a complete slice-plan.json or assignedStory fields before enforce-mode DEV admission; suggested slicing groups are diagnostic only and no child stories are created automatically.
